QuestInfo.name: The Ominous Brand
QuestInfo.0:
The monsters all have something in common: a mysterious magical brand.
According to Pan, they weren't always this ferocious. 

Is something in the forest causing all this? 
First, stop the monsters from attacking.
QuestInfo.1:
Pan tried to appease the branded animals, to no avail. 
To protect the forest, he stopped them by force. 

With him at your side, you're not alone. 
Don't be afraid.
QuestInfo.2:
You defeated the mysterious, brand-bearing monsters. 
At the same time, bits of old memories flashed through your mind.
 
Most of the faces were blurred, but you did recognize yourself... and Pan.
